title: BH 140 Multi-Survey Validation Package: Gaia DR3 Membership, HST/MGCS Photometry, WINERED Spectroscopy, and Candidate Outer Tidal Structure
description: Reproduction scripts and processed validation products for a multi-survey analysis of BH 140, including Gaia DR3 anchored membership, matched-control outer-structure validation, HST/MGCS artificial-star completeness and mass-function diagnostics, WINERED source-level crossmatch products, and phase-space Monte Carlo summaries. The package supports a control-tested candidate outer tidal-structure interpretation and does not claim a confirmed tidal tail or a radial mass-segregation detection.
